ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels comprising approximately 85-90% of the surface area, contrasted with high-intensity (white) linear and mottled pixel clusters comprising 10-15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density dark contiguous field across both lobes. High-contrast white mottling concentrated on the medial region of the left lobe; dispersed high-intensity white speckles and linear streaks distributed across the right lobe and central junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 35-40 degrees and significant depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of variations is highest on the inner half of the right lobe and the medial section of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips; leading edges exhibit a slight convex upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast circular and semi-circular white pixel clusters located on the proximal left lobe and both distal fluke tips, indicative of sessile organism attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned and parallel linear white pixel tracks (rake marks) visible on the central-right lobe and the lower-central region near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the right lobe surface; irregular jagged notches along the trailing edge contour; visible macro-organism colonization (barnacles) on the extreme distal edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity white mottled patch on the lower-left fluke surface near the peduncle junction.
